integrity.novelty_scope: Explicit three-qubit biseparable/NPT-across-every-cut witness proving nonconvexity of the 2009 mixed partitionwise-geometric construction; no priority claim for the fixed-cut convex roofs or for later convex-roof-of-the-whole geometric-mean measures.
integrity.proof_dependency: Exact rational density matrices and partial transposes, one \(\mathbb Q(\sqrt2)\) negative-eigenvalue witness, permutation symmetry, and the finite-dimensional zero-set characterization of the fixed-cut convex roofs.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the three-qubit \(m=2\) mixed-state member of the partitionwise-geometric construction.
It proves strict nonconvexity and positivity on one standard biseparable mixed state, but does not compute the positive value \(R_2(\rho_\star)\) exactly or classify the full nonconvexity region.
It does not assert failure of average LOCC monotonicity; convexity and the biseparable zero-set property are the proved failures.
A residual literature risk remains for poorly indexed notes or theses containing the same explicit obstruction.
title: A biseparable three-qubit state exposes nonconvexity of the mixed \(R_2\) construction
